presentation.description:
Your spirit companion engulfs your enemy completely, controlling its movement as you control its mind.

DAILY / STANDARD

Melee spirit 1

Target: One creature

Attack: Wisdom vs. Reflex

Hit: The target is dominated (save ends).

Miss: The target is dazed (save ends).

Effect: If your spirit companion is adjacent to the target at the start of its turn, you can slide the target up to 4 squares and slide your spirit companion up to 4 squares to a square adjacent to the target. This effect persists only while the target is dazed or dominated by this power.
